message: Preregistered the corrected checkpoint browser demo before CR-DYN-0008 produced its first held-out result. The existing five-minute poller will start it only after CR-DYN-0008/0009 complete and release the A10.
After the complete scale grid selected final_only-medium, the exclusive poller started the remote demo once as PID 74923.
The remote demo passed health and one real action-4 generated step; the returned PNG was step 1 with 9846.2 ms inference latency after 27232.5 ms warmup.

The local tunnel never passed health plus the required subsequent real step, and the DSW timer stopped the instance at 07:09. The exclusive poller restarted the same A10 but blocked on persisted stale demo PID 74923; localhost:7860 is not available.
evidence: poller:cycle_error local demo tunnel did not pass health and step checks

message: The stale demo PID was handled as a recoverable infrastructure interruption: its PID, ready marker, health/step evidence and log were moved into a timestamped archive before launching a fresh demo. No checkpoint, metric or failed evidence was deleted.

The blocker cleared. Fresh remote action 4 returned step 1, the dedicated launchd SSH tunnel passed local health, and local action 7 returned consecutive step 2 at 764.5 ms. The demo is technically ready and awaits user visual review.

User review rejected the demo: temporal generation was unusable and selected actions did not produce credible responses. Runtime plumbing remains verified, but the usable action-conditioned demo hypothesis is rejected.
